## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, indicating broad weekly participation, but the signal mix remains unresolved: VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION while Stocks/Bonds (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -3.36%) RECOVERY. Credit also remains mixed, with HYG/LQD (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear eased this week but remains elevated over the month: VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION. Credit stress is mixed: HYG/LQD (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%) is → flat, RECOVERY; Copper/Gold (1W: -2.03% | 1M: -9.24%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Mixed: Dollar Strength (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +2.48%) → flat, CORRECTION. Yield Curve (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.49%) → flat, BELOW TREND; Duration Preference (1W: -0.54% | 1M: -0.51%) → flat, BELOW TREND.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Rotation from Tech toward cyclicals and select defensives: XLY (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND, while XLK (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%) BELOW TREND; XLP (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND. Tech/Financials (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -11.80%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND; style favors Value over Growth, with breadth supporting the weekly rotation.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities bounced, but remain in recovery: SPY (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -5.70%) RECOVERY. India outperformed: INDA (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +12.78%) ABOVE TREND; EEM (1W: +2.38% | 1M: -8.53%) RECOVERY and FXI (1W: +0.63% | 1M: -1.45%) RECOVERY.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Small caps are rebounding: IWM (1W: +3.62% | 1M: -2.67%) RECOVERY. Speculation remains weak: ARKK (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -19.30%) RECOVERY, while IBIT (1W: -3.48% | 1M: -26.61%) BELOW TREND.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Copper remains under pressure: CPER (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -17.53%) BELOW TREND; gold is also weak, with GLD (1W: -0.23% | 1M: -10.47%) BELOW TREND. Agriculture is firmer versus the market: Agri/Market (1W: +1.10% | 1M: +3.22%) ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy is rebounding short term but weak over the month: XLE (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.91%) RECOVERY. Oil remains pressured: BNO (1W: +0.15% | 1M: -15.98%) RECOVERY; natural gas is pulling back from monthly gains: UNG (1W: -4.09% | 1M: +3.58%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Broad weekly participation is confirmed by 11/11 positive sectors; TLT (1W: +1.14% | 1M: +0.77%) ABOVE TREND, while SPY (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -5.70%) RECOVERY. Divergence remains in volatility: VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION; no major 1W/1M divergence across the core equity and bond ETF set.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Maintain a selective, neutral stance: favor areas showing relative strength such as XLY (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to weak momentum in XLK (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%) BELOW TREND and speculative weakness in ARKK (1W: +0.83% | 1M: -19.30%) RECOVERY.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: If broad participation persists, monitor XLY (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +4.02%) ABOVE TREND and XLP (1W: +3.14% | 1M: +6.73%) ABOVE TREND.
BEARISH: If technology weakness deepens, watch XLK (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: If the short-term rebound extends, monitor XLE (1W: +1.28% | 1M: -9.91%) RECOVERY.
BEARISH: If industrial demand concerns persist, watch CPER (1W: -1.48% | 1M: -17.53%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
Monitor VXX at 22.4000, currently (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION; HYG/LQD at 0.7366, (1W: +0.05% | 1M: -0.67%) → flat, RECOVERY. Stocks/Bonds at 8.9617, (1W: +1.36% | 1M: -3.36%) ↑ rising, RECOVERY; Tech/Financials at 2.8018, (1W: -3.98% | 1M: -11.80%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL; Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive, with weekly breadth strength offset by mixed risk and credit signals. Relative strength is broad but cyclicals and defensives are leading Tech, consistent with rotation toward Value. Monitor persistent monthly weakness in XLK (1W: -0.34% | 1M: -16.15%) BELOW TREND and elevated monthly volatility in VXX (1W: -6.00% | 1M: +25.91%) CORRECTION.
